summary: Tested the IMEI changes in Shitja vendore (/sale/new), the invoice (A4/80mm print and PDF), and returns. Backend pytest: 8 tests in /app/backend/tests/test_sale_imei.py, 5 passed. The 3 failures are edge-case bugs and none of them is in the requested scenarios. Playwright as admin: everything requested works. (1) Code P-00002 + Enter fills IMEI001 automatically; a 2nd row with P-00002 gets IMEI002; the datalist offers IMEI001..003; leaving and re-entering the code field does not change the IMEI. (2) A phone created with no IMEI and qty 2 shows an empty IMEI input with a red border. Saving it empty shows the toast 'IMEI mungon për ...'. Typing TESTUIIMEI1 and saving gives 'Fatura INV-2026-00009 u ruajt', qty drops to 1 and the IMEI is stored as sold. Selling the same IMEI again shows 'është shitur më parë'. Qty 0 with an unknown IMEI gives 'nuk është në stok' (API). (3) Returning through ReturnDialog gives 'Rikthimi u ruajt', qty goes back to 2, and the IMEI is in_stock again; it is auto-picked on the next sale. (4) The A4 print has the headers Shifra, Barkodi, Përshkrimi, IMEI / Garanci, Sasia, Çmimi, Totali with correct values in the page. 80mm shows 'P-00050 · barcode' and 'IMEI: ...' lines. GET /api/sales/{id}/invoice.pdf returns 200 with a valid %PDF; the column headers are confirmed in the code. (5) Regression: barcode 123456789099 + Enter fills P-00006, focus moves to the next row, the sale saves, and stock went 15 -> 14. HIGH: on screen, the A4 print page has a dark app background behind dark text, so the invoice values (Shifra/Barkodi/IMEI/Totals) cannot be read.

critical.issue: Not atomic. Items are checked and stock is changed one at a time. If a later item fails (e.g. a phone row with no IMEI, a duplicate IMEI in the same request, or not enough stock), the earlier items' stock is already reduced and their IMEIs already marked sold, but no sale is saved. Reproduced: accessory qty 5 + phone with no IMEI -> 400, and the accessory qty became 4. The UI lets the same IMEI be typed or picked in 2 rows, so this can lose stock.

minor.issue: An IMEI of only spaces ('   ') is accepted. The check `if not it.imei` runs before strip(), so the sale is saved with imei '' and an empty IMEI entry is added to the product. Strip first, then check.

Any unknown typed IMEI is accepted while quantity >= 1, even when all of the stock is registered IMEIs. Reproduced: a phone with 2 registered IMEIs (qty 2) sold with 'TESTRANDOM' -> 200, qty 1, but both registered IMEIs are still in_stock (2 in_stock IMEIs vs qty 1). Only allow an unregistered IMEI when quantity > the number of in_stock IMEIs.

ui_bugs.issue: The body keeps the app's global dark background rgb(11,15,23) and the invoice text is #111, so on screen the Shifra/Barkodi/Përshkrimi/IMEI cells, the invoice no., the client and the totals are invisible (also with emulate_media print). If the user prints with 'background graphics' on, the invoice is unreadable. If it is off, the white <th> header text prints on white paper. Fix: add `html,body{background:#fff !important;color:#111}` plus `-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact; print-color-adjust:exact` in the page <style>.

The error toast (top-right) covers the 'Ruaj' button for several seconds after a failed save; Playwright click was blocked by the sonner toast. The user has to wait or click the toast away before retrying.

integration_issues.issue: The datalist and free typing do not exclude IMEIs already used in other rows. The user can pick the same IMEI in 2 rows, which leads to the backend partial-write bug above.

issues: The IMEI column (w-36) is too narrow for a 15-digit IMEI; text is cut off ('ESTUIIMEI1')
The Barkodi column cuts off 13-digit EAN barcodes ('200840802')
Seeded P-00002 'iPhone T' has no barcode, so Barkodi stays empty for it (data issue, not code)

action_items: HIGH: PrintSalePage - force a white background / dark text and print-color-adjust:exact so the invoice (Shifra/Barkodi/IMEI) can be seen and prints correctly
HIGH: create_sale - check ALL items first (including duplicate IMEIs in the same request), then apply the stock/IMEI updates; or roll back on failure
Strip the IMEI before the empty check in create_sale
Only accept an unregistered IMEI when product.quantity > the number of in_stock IMEIs

SaleEntryPage: block or warn on duplicate IMEIs across rows and filter used IMEIs out of the datalist; widen the IMEI/Barkodi columns; move the toast position or add an offset so it does not cover Ruaj
critical_code_review_comments: create_sale is not atomic (see backend critical)
findByCode runs on blur too, so re-focusing the code field re-applies the product and resets sale_price/qty (discount is kept). It can overwrite a manually edited price
server.py is 1238 lines; split it into routers

success_rate.backend: 62% (5/8; all requested scenarios pass, 3 edge-case bugs)
success_rate.frontend: 90% (all requested flows work; the print page can't be read on screen)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_IMEI_* and TEST_UI_NoImeiPhone products plus their sales/returns; all deleted. The P-00006 accessory sale (INV-2026-00010) was deleted and its stock put back to 15. A leftover TEST_ sale INV-2026-00002 from a previous agent was also deleted. P-00002 IMEI001..003 are untouched (in_stock). Invoice numbers 00003-00010 were used up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_sale_imei.py cleans up via MongoDB (reads backend/.env). Its 3 failing tests (whitespace IMEI, random IMEI when all stock is registered, partial write) should pass after the fixes. To check the print page, use /print/sale/<id>?format=a4|80 with add_init_script('window.print=()=>{}'). The error toast blocks sale-save-btn, so use force=True.
